sources.entry: Betaflight Configurator - Cross platform configuration tool for the Betaflight firmware.

summary.one_liner: Betaflight Configurator is a cross-platform configuration and management app for the Betaflight flight controller firmware, delivered as a PWA and as standalone desktop/Android builds.
summary.what_it_does: The app configures and manages flight controllers running Betaflight, for aircraft such as quadcopters, hexacopters, octocopters and fixed-wing models. It is a Progressive Web Application hosted at app.betaflight.com, with a master snapshot at master.app.betaflight.com for unstable testing. Standalone installers are offered for Windows, Linux, Mac and Android via Releases. The codebase is moving to Node, npm, Vite, Vue and TypeScript, with Capacitor wrapping the PWA for Android. The UI includes a Modes tab with a search filter for mode names, and the app auto-detects system language with a manual language picker.
use_cases: set up quadcopter or fixed-wing flight modes
flash or tune Betaflight drone settings from a desktop
run the configurator in a browser without installing
build and develop the Vue/TypeScript configurator locally
how_to_run: Run the PWA locally: npm install
Build for production: npm run build
Preview the production build: npm run preview (or npm run review to build and preview together)
notable: Runs as a PWA in the browser with no install needed for the latest release
Standalone installers for Windows, Linux, Mac and Android
Mode list search filter on the Modes tab
Capacitor-based Android app with custom native plugins
Strict TypeScript and lint rules, including theme-token colour enforcement
caveats: The master snapshot is for testing only and can be buggy or corrupt flight controller settings
Mac users may need a terminal command to clear the quarantine flag on install (macOS 10.14 and 10.15 noted)
Linux needs serial port access (dialout group) and libatomic installed; some Ubuntu versions need special install steps
